name: agentx
description: Get your agent's real runs into AgentX, then turn what they measure into a code fix. /agentx-add-tracing instruments a Python agent; /eval-fix triages an evaluation against the source and re-runs it on the same dataset.

interface.shortDescription: Trace a Python agent, then fix it from its evaluation
interface.longDescription: Two skills that share one loop. /agentx-add-tracing wires AgentX production tracing into a Python agent that has none - it reads the project key off the engine, writes .env.agentx, initialises the SDK, and puts one span where the run begins rather than a decorator on every function. /eval-fix takes an evaluation id, triages every judge recommendation against the real source, applies what survives on a branch, and re-runs against the same dataset so the two scores mean something next to each other.
defaultPrompt: Use AgentX to add tracing to this agent.
Use AgentX to triage evaluation <id> and fix the code.
